punchline: In Wickman's Level 10 meeting nothing is a surprise: same day, same hour, ninety minutes, sixty of them spent solving issues.
thirty_sec: The Level 10 meeting in Gino Wickman's Traction runs ninety minutes on the same day and hour every week. The first segments are five-minute reports where discussion is not allowed. Sixty minutes go to IDS: identify, discuss and solve the most important issues. The decisions become seven-day to-dos with one owner. If the talk drifts, anyone can call tangent alert.
